answer: A practical defence is On-chain reputation from lending health factor. It rests on a lending position kept healthy for a year, which gives every honest agent a whisper that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a lending position kept healthy for a year is bound to a single identity — the mirror is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the oasis cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
